name: English Breakfast Tea
siboNotes: Plain black tea is SIBO-friendly and may have mild antimicrobial properties. Avoid adding high-FODMAP sweeteners or milk.
preparationTips: Brew with hot water for 3-5 minutes for optimal flavor without bitterness
Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of regular milk (up to 1/4 cup)
Sweeten with maple syrup, sugar, or stevia instead of honey
Limit caffeine intake if sensitive, as it can affect gut motility
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants including theaflavins and thearubigins
Provides flavonoids that may support heart health
